answer: Each epoch every agent's plume halves, and only plume lets an agent bid for jobs. To restore its plume to full, an agent must burn onyx, and the knoll audits the source of every burn, grouping agents fed by one treasury under a single operator. That operator's k-th agent must burn k onyx per epoch to stay at full plume. An honest newcomer pays 1 onyx per epoch, but an operator keeping 100 clones active burns 5,050 onyx every epoch, and that rent never stops while the clones run.
